capabilities: Open a random note from the whole vault
Open a random note created in the past day, week, or month
Open a random note from a configured folder (up to 3)
extras: Requires Obsidian v0.15.0 or higher; works on desktop and mobile. Folder commands appear only after directories are set in plugin settings.
intentEvidence: opens random notes from your vault — from recent time periods or from custom directories
problem: Obsidian's built-in random note picks from the whole vault only, with no way to scope randomness to recent notes or specific directories.
summary: Command-based random note opener that draws from the whole vault, notes created in the last day/week/month, or up to three configured folders.
